title: Creamy Gochujang Pasta with Indian-Spiced Umami Twist
style: Creamy, umami-rich fusion pasta combining Korean heat, Indian spices, and toasted sesame
description: A glossy, clingy, umami-rich creamy pasta with gochujang heat, Indian spices, miso depth, and a finishing touch of toasted sesame and fresh parsley.

items.note: or cashew cream for vegan version

items.item: squeeze of lime or lemon juice

steps: Cook Aromatics: Heat butter and oil over medium heat. Add shallots and cook until soft and translucent, 3–4 minutes.
Add garlic, gochujang paste, and red chili flakes. Stir 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Bloom Spices & Tomato Paste: Stir in cumin, coriander, garam masala, turmeric, red chili powder, tomato paste, and salt. Cook 30–45 seconds to bloom the spices.
Add Milk & Miso: Lower heat to medium-low. Add milk (or cashew cream) and miso paste, whisk to combine. Simmer 2–3 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Add Pasta & Optional Veggies: Toss in cooked pasta and any optional roasted mushrooms or spinach. Stir well to coat evenly.
Finish with Sesame & Herbs: Drizzle in toasted sesame oil and stir in toasted sesame seeds. Sprinkle chopped parsley, adjust salt and chili to taste, and serve hot.
tips: Bloom the spices properly for deeper, more complex flavour.
Use white miso and toasted sesame oil to layer umami.
Reserve a splash of pasta water to loosen sauce if needed.
Optional roasted mushrooms or spinach add extra texture and richness.
Add extra chili flakes or gochujang for more heat.
Serve immediately for glossy, clingy sauce.
